summary_md: **Sandeep Alluru ([@sandeep_alluru](https://x.com/sandeep_alluru/status/2115567439366799410))** reports **Keel H3 Turbo**, fitting MiniMax H3 onto a single DGX Spark and cutting a render job from 635 s to 201 s; the accompanying X article links the sandeep-alluru/keel-h3-turbo GitHub repo.
relevance: Shows a single-Spark deployment recipe for a max-tier open model with a measured 3x speedup.
